family_treatment.name: CONCUSSIVE FRACTURE
family_treatment.evidence: 2026-10-19 director: 'Approved, proceed' to family and Blast Shield as first target
family_treatment.palette: Ember orange, incandescent gold, white-hot yellow, charcoal and burnt copper; deep crimson only as restrained accent; blue-white electrical trace only when supported (Charge 4 Explosion).
family_treatment.material: Concussive detonation: fractured stone, compressed chakra pressure and sharp blast-fronts, not lava, persistent fire or hydrothermal vapor.
family_treatment.rendering: Premium TNR crisp pixel clusters, coherent focal silhouette with dark negative space, one secondary effect, 125/64/32 legibility, no anatomy unless separately approved.

targets.name: Inferno Cataclysm
targets.action: Detonate a fissure in the ground into a devastating area eruption; historical capture describes fractured earth and explosive recoil.
targets.dominant_silhouette: One long, jagged split in the earth erupting into a brutal angled wall of incandescent pressure; no isolated fireball.
targets.camera: Elevated three-quarter view, looking down the torn ground plane; fissure clearly extends into depth.
targets.motion_axis: Lateral force tears ground open from the central crack while explosive pressure erupts upward toward the far edge.
targets.secondary_effect: One massive displaced stone slab to show violent ground breakup.

sibling_exclusions.silhouette: One compressed luminous projectile breaking apart into a controlled fan/constellation of smaller detonations; a distinct multi-burst breakup. ACTION: The main projectile travels toward the target then bursts radially into multiple distinct small charges.

A thick horseshoe-shaped compressed explosive-pressure wall with an unmistakably protected dark central void; the shield actively deflects an incoming strike. ACTION: Pressure drives outward from the protected center, while one incoming attack is redirected away from the wall.

A staggered, diagonal chain of small ground-contact detonations across a broad battlefield swath, NOT one large fireball or ring. ACTION: A controlled cascade propagates from the near lower-left ignition to the far upper-right detonation.

A single compressed diagonal shock-cone with a leading high-energy terminal collision blast and a sharply separate propulsion jet behind. ACTION: Fast thrust from upper-left to lower-right: narrow wake opens toward one hard, localized close-range impact.

direction_approval.evidence: Director, 2026-10-19, persistent Bakuhatsu Art Studio: “Approved” in direct response to the proposed Inferno Cataclysm ground-fissure/explosive-wall target direction and explicit approval request.

targets.name: Charge 4 Explosion
targets.action: Disperse explosive chakra across the battlefield, making successive microexplosions at contact points; offensive charging and afterburn.
targets.dominant_silhouette: The visible C4 silhouette is BUILT FROM distinct explosions on the battlefield: a broad curved C of ground-contact blast nodes on the left and a sharply angled 4 of blast nodes on the right, preserving dark gaps; not flat typography, a glyph floating in space, or a generic diagonal explosion chain.
targets.camera: Elevated three-quarter, near-overhead view of dark rocky battleground, preserving the legibility of the C on the left and 4 on the right while showing ignition points physically contacting ground.
targets.motion_axis: Linked concussive detonations ignite around the left-side C curve and then through the angled strokes of the right-side 4; the chain is a field spread and contact-based cascade, not a single straight diagonal attack.
targets.secondary_effect: One restrained network of intermittent thin blue-white chakra filaments connecting some ignition points; all other stray sparks and debris are subordinate.

sibling_exclusions.silhouette: The approved Inferno Cataclysm is a huge earth fissure shattering dark slabs and erupting a tall white-hot detonation wall; no broad ground fault or upward eruption in the C4 ground-contact pattern.

The approved Kinetic Nova is an airborne asymmetric radial constellation of five large starburst detonations from one disintegrating core; C4 must consist of ground-contact nodes arranged as a curved C plus angular 4, not floating radial bursts.

The approved Blast Shield is a nearly enclosing protective circular barrier with a dark center and an inbound deflected projectile; C4 uses separate contact blasts with intentional gaps, no continuous shield wall or protected center.

Howitzer Crash is a concentrated upper-left-to-lower-right blast-propulsion shock-wedge terminating in one massive lower-right close-range impact; C4 must not look like a thrust path or single terminal strike.

direction_approval.evidence: Director, Bakuhatsu Art Studio 2026-10-19: superseded earlier v1 diagonal-chain direction by requesting a 'C4' silhouette made of explosions, then explicitly 'Yep, do that'. Later, responding to exact visually rendered C4 image 1000018870.png: 'So perfect. Approved. Next'. This v2 lock records the approved C4 composition; the original jutsu combat action remains from historical capture.

targets.negative_space: Unlit charcoal ground clearly separates the C arc from the 4 and keeps the openings of each shape recognizable at 125, 64 and 32 px.

targets.name: Howitzer Crash
targets.action: Represent Howitzer Crash as blast-propelled high-speed approach followed by one close-contact detonation. The zig-zag boot-tread scorch impressions are an art-direction metaphor for rapid explosive footwork, not a source-verified number of combat steps.
targets.dominant_silhouette: A sequence of THREE or FOUR large, staggered, angular burnt boot-tread/footfall-shaped chakra imprints zig-zags along the dark ground from distant upper-left toward lower-right. An offset compact, flattened asymmetric impact flash terminates the trail. Footfall silhouettes and direction changes, NOT a continuous beam, giant fireball, full-frame fracture, C4 letters or a string of identical explosion starbursts, dominate.
targets.camera: Elevated near-overhead three-quarter view along a ground plane: show the separate scorching propulsion imprints at differing depths with a clear stepped zig-zag and one compact near-field contact burst in the lower-right. No side-on projectile or wall-height detonation.
targets.motion_axis: Fast movement with TWO deliberate lateral changes of direction as propulsion marks hop from side to side down a broken Z track toward the final lower-right collision; several dark gaps divide the marks; no linear, white-hot diagonal jet.
targets.secondary_effect: One short fading copper-orange spark tail immediately behind the most recent boot-tread scorch; all other steps are restrained dark/hot imprints rather than miniature explosions.

sibling_exclusions.silhouette: Approved Inferno Cataclysm: ground split by jagged high stone slabs with a towering wall of white-hot upward eruption. Howitzer v2 has NO large broken stone plane, debris eruption, vertical blast column or central ground fault; marks leave ground mostly intact.

Approved Kinetic Nova: one airborne central projectile rupturing into five large separated radial explosion starbursts. Howitzer v2 is a ground-hugging zig-zag path of charred footfall imprints ending at ONE short terminal flash; no floating multi-burst constellation.

Approved Blast Shield: near-enclosing thick circular concussive barrier with protected dark hollow and one incoming projectile deflected. Howitzer v2 has no protective circular ring, dome or projectile.

Approved Charge 4 v2: bright contact detonations spell curved C left and angular 4 right, linked by blue-white charge. Howitzer v2 has DARK heel/tread-shaped propulsion scorch impressions in a broken Z zig-zag with a SINGLE compact end impact; no C4 letters, repeated equal white-hot nodes or electrical links.

direction_approval.evidence: Director, 2026-10-20, Bakuhatsu persistent Art Studio: “Approved” in direct response to the Howitzer Crash v2 BLAST-STEP ZIGZAG (three or four staggered dark/hot propulsion imprints with two zig-zag direction changes and one compact terminal blast). This supersedes rejected v1 composition only, not the technique’s source-supported mechanics. Raw visual approval remains PENDING.

targets.negative_space: A lot of unbroken dark charcoal ground remains between the three or four large zig-zag scorch imprints and around the single compact terminal flash. Keep the outline readable at 125, 64 and 32px; not a C4 alphabet figure or giant radial fireball.
